title: Helpful Tips
description: The server randomly sends you mostly unhelpful tips.
body:
Every once in a while, you'll get a usually unhelpful tip in chat. Tips include:
- You're standing on a(n) [block]!
- There are [count] hostile mobs nearby.
- Dying is bad!
- [player] is [distance] blocks away from you! (only appears in multiplayer)
